prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Your companion control guide is saved in preferences for quick reference.", "How to Control Your Desktop Pet", "Click to interact, right-click to open pet settings or hide, and drag your companion anywhere on your screen."]
1: ["Choose Your Starting Companion Archetype", "Select a companion style below to begin customizing your desktop companion."]
2: ["Companion Account Protection", "Your pet customization and adoption progress are permanently linked to your account for multi-device sync.", "Cloud Save Active"]
3: ["Generating Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet models and animations are being assembled and prepared for desktop launch."]
4: ["Sign In to Protect & Sync Your Pet", "Creating or connecting your account locks your companion traits to your profile so your pet is never lost."]
5: ["Look for your companion icon in the system tray or menu bar to quickly hide or summon your pet anytime."]
6: ["Configuring companion desktop integration in your system tray so your pet can spawn seamlessly when ready."]
7: ["Includes Free Cloud Sync & Custom Companion Styles"]
8: ["Desktop Companion Permissions", "Grant desktop overlay permissions to allow your companion to walk freely across your desktop windows.", "Enable Desktop Display"]
9: ["This official adoption certificate is automatically synced to your signed-in account for safe keeping."]
